title: Introduction to the IQB-Studio with eatPrepTBA
text: Using workspace object, can now extract units using get_units() function. function allows look many units , instead go one one like Studio. Depending many workspaces access, might take moment load. get_units() returns tibble one row per unit several metadata columns, including nested list-columns. tibble contains following variables: Four variables already familiar workspace information: ws_id: ID respective workspace ws_label: name respective workspace wsg_id: ID workspace group respective workspace wsg_label: name workspace group respective workspace Like workspaces, unit unique ID label. unit also unit key sometimes description information state. unit_id: unique ID unit. unit_label: label (name) unit. unit_key: short name unit. group_name: group assigned unit. description: description notes stored unit. state_id: state set, variable 0. package can also attach corresponding state_label (e.g. state_id = 1 means “zu klären”) state_color settings exist.   Studio, tab “Verona Module” shows information software component behind unit’s editor, preview, coding interface. editor: editor module assigned unit player: preview/runtime module assigned unit schemer: coding module assigned unit check updates changes via Editor, can look variables starting last_change. last_change_definition: timestamp last change unit definition. last_change_definition_user: user last changed unit definition. last_change_scheme: timestamp last change coding scheme. last_change_scheme_user: user last changed coding scheme. last_change_metadata: timestamp last change metadata. last_change_metadata_user: user last changed metadata.  coding scheme unit defines responses unit interpreted scored. get_units() returns JSON format.
